1. PAYCORP SOLUTIONS PVT LTD Project 1- NPCI Mandates & Payment Platform(NACH, UPI Autopay, APBS)
04/2024 – Present
Worked on end-to-end NPCI-aligned project supporting NACH, UPI Autopay, e-Mandate, Paper Mandates and Aadhaar- based services (Aadhaar Seeding/ Deseeding, APB credit, BASE). •Led requirement gathering for the complete mandate and transaction lifecycle, including onboarding, validation, execution, reconciliation, and exception handling. •Prepared BRD, FRD/ FSD, solution scope, and process flow documents in line with NPCI and bank regulatory guidelines.
cbchandanbrahma@gmail.com
Designed and reviewed inward and outward mandate and payment flows, covering authentication, consent, settlement, and reversals. •Coordinated with banks, NPCI and internal stakeholders to support UAT, certification, audit readiness, and production go-live. •Supported onboarding and processing of 1+ million records, achieving >99% mandate success rate post go-live
Project 2: API-Driven Rent Collection & Mandate Platform
Worked on API-driven integration project for Sohar International bank connecting Core Banking Systems, CBO, and partner platforms for rent collection •Gathered and analyzed requirements for APIs including account enquiry, authentication, UI design, mandate execution, debit/ credit posting, and status callbacks. •Performed interface analysis and data mapping, ensuring secure and reliable data exchange across systems. •Acted as a liaison between business, product, and development teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and high- availability integrations. •Improved turnaround time for mandate execution and status updates by 30–40% through streamlined API flows. •Configured Postman requests for seamless integration and testing of web services, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. •Supported development processes, monitored deployments, and ensured smooth functionality post-implementation. •Managed integrations over APIs and web services, enabling efficient communication and data exchange between systems.
Project 3: Regulatory, Audit & Information Security Compliance
Supported information security, regulatory, and audit initiatives in the organisation. •Actively involved in VAPT, SOC 2, ISO 27001:2022, and PCI DSS audits, including coordination with auditors and internal teams. •Assisted in control documentation, evidence collection, audit observation tracking, and remediation closure. •Ensured compliance with security, audit, NPCI, UIDAI, and regulatory requirements across applications and processes. •Worked with stakeholders to mitigate risks and support audit sign-off and regulatory readiness. •Supported 100% audit closure on time across VAPT, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS with zero critical observations
2. BARODA GLOBAL SHARED SERVICES LIMITED
03/2021 – 04/2024 •Elicited and documented business requirements for payments and trade finance by collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex business needs into actionable functional and technical specifications •Led gap analysis and automation for International Wire Payment via inward SWIFT messaging (MT103), google payments, and cross-border transaction initiatives, ensuring comprehensive data mapping and compliance adherence •Facilitated stakeholder workshops and requirement walkthroughs between business units, technology teams, and vendors to ensure solution alignment with business objectives and regulatory frameworks •Enhanced the existing mobile application by integrating outward forex transactions, loans, insurance, and reinsurance services into a unified platform for improved customer convenience and usability.
3. INNODATATICS INC(Internship) Project name - Term deposit subscription
02/2020 – 02/2021
Problem Statement - There has been a revenue decline for the bank and they would like to know what actions to take. After investigation, it was found out that the root cause is that customers are not depositing as frequently as before. Knowing that term deposits allow banks to hold onto a deposit for a specific amount of time, so banks can invest in higher-gain financial products to make a profit. As a result, the bank would like to identify existing customers who have a higher chance to subscribe for a term deposit and focus marketing efforts on such customers. Workflow- Problem identification, Requirement elicitation, documentation, database, export data from database to CSV format to get data insights, dashboarding, architecture, development, testing, and integration to the system. Tools- Google Docs, SQL, Power BI, Python.
4. AXIS BANK LTD
06/2018 – 01/2020 Different Data-driven customer-centric approaches to target customers for getting high accuracy in pitching products like Insurance, Reinsurance, Mutual funds, Term deposits, Auto Loans, Home Loans, Cash Credit, Education Loans, Personal Loans, Corporate Banking, Term Loans, Overdrafts, Credit cards. Maintaining a portfolio of HNI customers using Microsoft Excel for quick and better services. Handling NEFT, RTGS, CASA, Forex Prepaid / Wallets.

1. PAYCORP SOLUTIONS PVT LTD Project 1- NPCI Mandates & Payment Platform(NACH, UPI Autopay, APBS)
04/2024 – Present
Worked on end-to-end NPCI-aligned project supporting NACH, UPI Autopay, e-Mandate, Paper Mandates and Aadhaar- based services (Aadhaar Seeding/ Deseeding, APB credit, BASE). •Led requirement gathering for the complete mandate and transaction lifecycle, including onboarding, validation, execution, reconciliation, and exception handling. •Prepared BRD, FRD/ FSD, solution scope, and process flow documents in line with NPCI and bank regulatory guidelines.
cbchandanbrahma@gmail.com
Designed and reviewed inward and outward mandate and payment flows, covering authentication, consent, settlement, and reversals. •Coordinated with banks, NPCI and internal stakeholders to support UAT, certification, audit readiness, and production go-live. •Supported onboarding and processing of 1+ million records, achieving >99% mandate success rate post go-live
Project 2: API-Driven Rent Collection & Mandate Platform
Worked on API-driven integration project for Sohar International bank connecting Core Banking Systems, CBO, and partner platforms for rent collection •Gathered and analyzed requirements for APIs including account enquiry, authentication, UI design, mandate execution, debit/ credit posting, and status callbacks. •Performed interface analysis and data mapping, ensuring secure and reliable data exchange across systems. •Acted as a liaison between business, product, and development teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and high- availability integrations. •Improved turnaround time for mandate execution and status updates by 30–40% through streamlined API flows. •Configured Postman requests for seamless integration and testing of web services, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. •Supported development processes, monitored deployments, and ensured smooth functionality post-implementation. •Managed integrations over APIs and web services, enabling efficient communication and data exchange between systems.
Project 3: Regulatory, Audit & Information Security Compliance
Supported information security, regulatory, and audit initiatives in the organisation. •Actively involved in VAPT, SOC 2, ISO 27001:2022, and PCI DSS audits, including coordination with auditors and internal teams. •Assisted in control documentation, evidence collection, audit observation tracking, and remediation closure. •Ensured compliance with security, audit, NPCI, UIDAI, and regulatory requirements across applications and processes. •Worked with stakeholders to mitigate risks and support audit sign-off and regulatory readiness. •Supported 100% audit closure on time across VAPT, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS with zero critical observations
2. BARODA GLOBAL SHARED SERVICES LIMITED
03/2021 – 04/2024 •Elicited and documented business requirements for payments and trade finance by collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex business needs into actionable functional and technical specifications •Led gap analysis and automation for International Wire Payment via inward SWIFT messaging (MT103), google payments, and cross-border transaction initiatives, ensuring comprehensive data mapping and compliance adherence •Facilitated stakeholder workshops and requirement walkthroughs between business units, technology teams, and vendors to ensure solution alignment with business objectives and regulatory frameworks •Enhanced the existing mobile application by integrating outward forex transactions, loans, insurance, and reinsurance services into a unified platform for improved customer convenience and usability.
3. INNODATATICS INC(Internship) Project name - Term deposit subscription
02/2020 – 02/2021
Problem Statement - There has been a revenue decline for the bank and they would like to know what actions to take. After investigation, it was found out that the root cause is that customers are not depositing as frequently as before. Knowing that term deposits allow banks to hold onto a deposit for a specific amount of time, so banks can invest in higher-gain financial products to make a profit. As a result, the bank would like to identify existing customers who have a higher chance to subscribe for a term deposit and focus marketing efforts on such customers. Workflow- Problem identification, Requirement elicitation, documentation, database, export data from database to CSV format to get data insights, dashboarding, architecture, development, testing, and integration to the system. Tools- Google Docs, SQL, Power BI, Python.
4. AXIS BANK LTD
06/2018 – 01/2020 Different Data-driven customer-centric approaches to target customers for getting high accuracy in pitching products like Insurance, Reinsurance, Mutual funds, Term deposits, Auto Loans, Home Loans, Cash Credit, Education Loans, Personal Loans, Corporate Banking, Term Loans, Overdrafts, Credit cards. Maintaining a portfolio of HNI customers using Microsoft Excel for quick and better services. Handling NEFT, RTGS, CASA, Forex Prepaid / Wallets.
